decision_rationale: ChatNT is presented as a new multimodal model, not a wrapper. The methods explicitly describe an autoregressive English decoder and pretrained DNA/English components, with broad task coverage across DNA, RNA, and protein sequences.
evidence_snippet: “returns a distribution over English words that is used to autoregressively produce an answer in English”; “pretrained DNA encoder” and “pretrained English decoder”; “solve multiple biologically relevant downstream tasks”
